correctness: Existing AXPY driver: every element at N=1024, 1000000 and 10000000, plus alpha=-2 and alpha=0 at N=1024; every timed process also checks its full output after timing. Tolerances rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12.
sampling: Independent processes; kernel time divided by fixed inner repeats. Each input has complete randomized configuration rounds, warmups excluded. Same seed and source bytes across sessions. No pooling across inputs or sessions.
holdout: Freeze all session-1 choices and archive hashes before session 2 begins. Reapply without retuning. Oracle is smallest session-2 median including sequential; descriptive inadequacy means more than 2% slower.
statistics: Median, mean, sample SD, MAD, IQR; paired complete-round percentile bootstrap with 5000 resamples and seed 2026 for 95% conditional intervals. No population/significance claim from two sessions.
cost: Actual deterministic pipeline preparation cost per input, including compilation, correctness and sampling. Amortization on both same-session and held-out kernel times. No new LLM/promotion cost is claimed; prefix-only estimate is a lower bound for full admission.
power: Do not begin while charge is critically low and falling. Record power/charge before and after sessions. Prefer stable external power; no exclusive host, frequency or thermal control is claimed.
scope: One AXPY source, three fixed input sizes, deterministic generation. No new kernel, repair loop, hardware profiler, LLM architecture, or causal DRAM/cache claim. Existing results are not overwritten.
